title: The Cloister and the Hearth
author: Charles Reade
description: "The Cloister and the Hearth" by Charles Reade is a historical novel published in 1861.
longDescription: Set in 15th-century Europe, it follows Gerard Eliassoen, a young scribe whose journey takes him far from his beloved Margaret.
